gate.popup: Your browser blocked the sign-in window. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
gate.pitch_title: Your files, on your Nookara account.
gate.pitch: Upload anything, keep it in folders and get to it from any browser. Your files have no public links.
gate.lead: Drive has its own sign-in. Your Nookara account stays signed in where it is.
gate.fine: You choose what Drive may do on the next screen.

home.title: Welcome back, {name}.
home.empty_hint: Press New, or drop files anywhere on this page.

drive.read_only: You signed in with Read only, so you can look and download but not change anything. Sign out and back in to change that.

shared.view_note: This was shared with you to view. Only people with edit access can change it.
shared.edit_note: This was shared with you to edit. What you add here belongs to its owner and uses their storage.
shared.none_hint: Everything is private until you share it. Right-click a file or folder and choose Share.
shared.with_me_none: Nothing has been shared with you yet

bin.note: Files in the bin still count toward your storage, and are deleted for good after {days} days.
bin.empty_body: Everything in it is deleted for good. This can't be undone.

media.app_note: What this app uploaded. Anyone with the link to one of these can open it.
media.note: Pictures, video and audio you uploaded through Ember and other apps. These have public links, so anyone with the link can open them. Your Drive files do not.
media.delete_body: Its link stops working, including anywhere you've posted it. This can't be undone.

apps.note: What games and apps saved to your account. You can look, but only the app that saved it can change it. To clear something, use My Account > Storage.
apps.none: No app has saved anything yet
apps.truncated: (This is too big to show all of it, so only the start is here.)

link.gone: This link doesn't work any more
link.gone_hint: Its owner may have turned it off or deleted the file.
link.read_only: You signed in with Read only, so you can only view this. Sign out and back in to edit it.
link.edit_note: You can look without an account. Sign in to Nookara to edit it.

share.link_off: Off: nobody can open this with a link.
share.link_edit: Anyone can view it. Signing in to Nookara lets them edit it.
share.link_view: Anyone can view it, no account needed.
share.title: Share "{name}"

pv.none: There's no preview for this kind of file.
pv.none2: Download it to open it on your device.
pv.truncated: (Only the start of this file is shown. Download it to see the rest.)

drive.err_full: Your storage is full. Delete something or upgrade to Nookara Pro.
drive.err_name_taken: Something with that name is already in this folder.
drive.err_suspended: Uploads are turned off on your account for now.
drive.err_into_itself: A folder can't go inside itself.
drive.err_too_deep: Folders can only go so deep. Pick a higher one.
drive.err_too_many: You have the most files and folders one Drive can hold.
drive.err_scope: You signed in with Read only, so Drive can't change anything. Sign out and back in to allow it.
drive.err_view_only: You can only view this. Ask its owner for edit access.
drive.err_owner_only: Only its owner can do that.
drive.err_other_drive: That can't move there: it stays on its owner's Drive.
drive.err_thats_you: That's you. You already have it.
drive.err_too_many_shares: That's the most people one thing can be shared with. A link works for more.
drive.err_rate_limited: You've shared a lot in the last hour. Try again later.
